text:
**Failure mode:** Connection failure (missing OAuth scope on the Gmail Connection)

**Where it went wrong:** Step 2 of the AOP, at the first tool call, `gmail.send_message` in transcript turn [2]. The Connection 'Purchasing' was granted only `gmail.readonly` and `gmail.labels`, so the send call was rejected before any email left. The Agent handled the failure correctly by stopping, but it did not reach Step 3, so no row was logged either.

**Evidence:**
> ERROR 403: Request had insufficient authentication scopes. Required: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send

> Gmail Connection 'Purchasing' granted scopes: gmail.readonly, gmail.labels.

**Fix:** Re-authorize the Gmail Connection 'Purchasing' so it includes the `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send` scope. Only the Connection needs changing; the AOP is fine as written.

**Next step:** Re-grant the Gmail scope in Connections, then start a new Run. Once the Connection has `gmail.send`, Step 2 should succeed, and Step 3 will append the row. I can also check whether the AOP needs a fallback branch for a future scope loss, though I don't think one is needed for this failure.
